why: No major reviewer or authority appears; the only readable answers are two niche spec-comparison sites (homepowerfacts, testedwatts) that openly do not test, a generic calculator page, an affiliate roundup not focused on 1 kWh units, and an off-topic listicle passage. Seven of twelve results returned no text at all. A focused page listing which 1,000 Wh-class stations clear a 1,500 W-input microwave, with tested cycles, runtime and current prices, would stand out, as it did on the solar kit question.
